scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace=@four/shared && concurrently -k -n client,server -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace=@four/client" "npm run dev --workspace=@four/server"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@four/shared && npm run build --workspace=@four/client && npm run build --workspace=@four/server
scripts.smoke:production: npm run build && npm run smoke:production --workspace=@four/server
